title: A machine learning approach to brain epigenetic analysis reveals kinases associated with Alzheimer's disease.
summary: The primary study applies EWASplus machine learning to extrapolate epigenome-wide association signals and reports candidate Alzheimer’s-associated loci/kinases, with targeted bisulfite sequencing for a subset. This supports an association result; it does not establish kinase causality. Organization is unavailable in the deposited bibliographic metadata.
